ai_settings_connection_scope: Rust currently supports the registered OpenAI-compatible connection only. Changes are session-local, never persisted. Configure a request and approve its exact payload before sending.
ai_settings_import_unavailable: Local Codex/Claude import and trusted credential storage are not connected in Rust. Existing files and credentials are not read.
ai_settings_credential_status: Credentials are entered only in request preflight, cleared after use and never written to preferences.
ai_settings_models_unavailable: Only host-registered models and endpoints are allowed. Remote model discovery is unavailable; changing these fields cannot register a new destination.
ai_settings_valid: Configuration matches the trusted catalog. This is not a connection test or request approval.
ai_settings_invalid: Configuration is not in the trusted catalog. No request was made and no settings were saved.
ai_settings_package_unavailable: Package management is unavailable in the Rust runtime. Import, trust, version selection and removal remain disabled; no package code is loaded or executed.
ai_settings_permissions_unavailable: Policy management is not connected. These permissions are not granted. Script execution still requires a qualified sandbox and explicit run approval.
ai_settings_report_unavailable: Report-format and language preferences are not connected to the Rust AI report pipeline. Disabled values are reference defaults, not applied settings.
ai_settings_history_policy: Reference retention: 100 conversations / 30 days. Rust currently stores bounded audit metadata, not a managed conversation-history collection.
